messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy/rollout] blue-green rollout started: service=edge-router, version=v2.14, regions=[apac, eu-west], initial weights={apac:20, eu-west:10}. trigger=manual by @jordan :rocket:
oncall-bot: Pager triggered — P1: high-5xx-rate on edge-router in APAC. Paging maya (primary on-call). :rotating_light:
maya: on it. seeing a spike in 502s in APAC canary within last 90s. metrics: 502_rate ↑ 18x, p95 latency ↑ 2x. Can anyone confirm if this rollout touched lb config or traffic-shaping?
jordan: I kicked the rollout for v2.14 at 09:14. No manual LB changes from my side, just feature flag flip and deployment to the new green pool.
emma: support-bot showing some customer errors — several Prod customers in APAC reporting generation timeouts. Ticket count increased.
support-bot: 6 new tickets tagged edge-router/APAC since 09:16, customers: alpha-shop, quickforms, data-io. Severity: degraded UX.
leo: running quick healthcheck to the green pool in apac:```bash
# curl -sv https://apac-edge-green.internal/v2/health
* Connected to apac-edge-green.internal (10.2.3.4) port 443
> GET /v2/health HTTP/1.1
> Host: apac-edge-green.internal
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
{"status":"down","upstream_errors":12}
```
ops-nerd: dig check for apac-edge cluster endpoints looks fine DNS-wise, A records point to expected IPs. TTL is 60s. The mismatch seems at L7 proxy or upstream routing.
maya: agree. 502 body shows upstream_errors — suggests new green instances failing to connect to model-backend (maybe env/secret mismatch). Can someone check env vars / secrets for green pool?
jordan: checking deploy logs... looks like green pool instances were built from image tagged v2.14. Release notes show change: switch default KV cache host to redis-green.internal. Did we forget to provision redis access in APAC?
emma: looking at infra—APAC redis-cluster has only blue credentials. green used a different IAM role that wasn't granted in apac account. Oops.
maya: immediate mitigation: reduce APAC traffic to green to 0% and stop further rollout in other regions. Two options: 1) toggle feature flag rollout.edge_green to off 2) adjust LB weight. Which is faster?
jordan: feature flag change should be fastest and safe. Flag name: rollout.edge_green. I can flip it.
emma: ^ also remember we need to open a kill-switch for the deploy pipeline to prevent auto-resume. Set pipeline.pause=true.
jordan: executing flag toggle...```bash
# curl -XPOST https://flags.redwood/internal/flags/rollout.edge_green/toggle -d '{"enabled":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxxxxxx'
{"status":"ok","flag":"rollout.edge_green","enabled":false}
```
maya: confirmed via metrics console — green APAC traffic dropped to 0% within 12s. 502s dropping back to baseline. p95 latency improving. Good.
support-bot: customer ticket surge subsiding. 4 of 6 new tickets have automatic follow-ups sent: "we're investigating and temporarily routing your requests to fallback pool".
ops-nerd: adding LB action as a secondary safety net — reducing weight for apac green pool to 0 via cli:```bash
# infractl lb set-weight --cluster apac --pool green --weight 0
result: ok
```
leo: after flag flip + lb weight, healthchecks show green instances still returning 502 for health endpoint — so root cause still repros if green gets traffic. We'll need to rebuild the image with correct redis creds.
maya: agree. For now create incident page and assign action items. I'll escalate to on-call handoff: I'm going to handoff to @jordan for follow-up/prep of rollback or rebuild. Summary to include customer impact, mitigation applied, proposed next steps.
oncall-bot: Incident 2026-APAC-GREEN created and assigned to maya and jordan. Severity: P1 -> degraded multi-customer. Start time: 1988880000. Incident channel: #inc-2026-apac-green.
jordan: taking over. Next steps: 1) coordinate with infra to provision redis role to green or rebuild with blue redis host, 2) prepare hotfix image v2.14.1 with env fix, 3) validate in a small canary in apac (5%) before increasing.
emma: infra is provisioning role now, ETA ~20m. If infra can't get role approved, we'll rebuild with existing blue redis host to expedite.
leo: I'll start a diagnostic run to collect logs from green instances and open a debug bundle:```bash
# diagctl collect --cluster apac --pool green --since 10m --out /tmp/apac-green-debug.tar.gz
collected: /tmp/apac-green-debug.tar.gz
```
maya: thanks. Also please annotate customer-facing tickets with "mitigation applied: routing reverted to stable pool; engineers investigating root cause". Keep legal/compliance in the loop for any data exposure risk — probably low.
support-bot: updated tickets and bumped priority to high for alpha-shop & quickforms.
jordan: I'll stay on the incident and loop SRE infra. If rebuild needed, I'll coord deploy. @emma @leo ping me when infra role is ready or debug bundle analyzed.
ops-nerd: note: DNS TTL small helped — quick rollback was effective. Recommend recommending TTL 30s for future rollouts during cross-region changes.
maya: handing off fully to @jordan now. I'm going to sign out in 10 to handle paging follow-ups. Thanks all. :heart:
jordan: ack takeover. I'll post updates in #inc-2026-apac-green. Current status: mitigation applied (flag off, LB weight 0), customer impact reduced, next action: infra role or image rebuild. ETA 20-30m.
oncall-bot: Incident 2026-APAC-GREEN updated: status=mitigated, assigned=jordan, update_ts=1988880375.
